extDescription.message: Keep the history of chosen sites from being saved or synced, while staying signed in.

cmdToggleSite.message: Toggle protection for the current site

badgeBlocked.message: Browser policy forbids deleting history; the extension cannot work

blockedWarning.message: Browser policy forbids deleting history (common on work or school devices). The extension cannot work here.

disabledWarning.message: The extension is off. Visits to protected sites will be kept in history.

unsupportedPage.message: This is not a regular web page.

removeParentHint.message: This rule also protects other addresses; they will lose protection too.

rulesIntro.message: History of addresses matching a rule is deleted right after each visit. Domain-only rules include subdomains by default; path rules match by path segment, e.g. /foo matches /foo/bar but not /foobar.

errScheme.message: Only http and https addresses are supported

confirmDeleteRule.message:
Delete rule "$RULE$"?

Deleted history cannot be restored. After the rule is removed, visits to this address will be kept in history.

noRules.message: No rules yet. Add an address above.

sweepHint.message: A quick sweep searches history by domain and is fast. A full sweep checks every history entry and may take a while for large histories. Both run automatically on a schedule.

optPurgeOnAdd.message: When adding a rule, delete existing history for it

optCleanRecentlyClosedHint.message: Works by briefly re-adding a history entry and deleting it, which triggers Chrome's cleanup. With history sync on, this adds one more very short upload window.

optCleanDownloads.message: Remove download entries from protected addresses (files are kept)

optCleanDownloadsHint.message: Turning this on requests the "Manage your downloads" permission.

permissionDenied.message: Permission was not granted; the feature stays off.

optShowIndicator.message: Show a colored toolbar icon on protected tabs

optShowIndicatorHint.message: Turn off if you do not want others to notice from the icon.

syncIntro.message: Deletions also create sync delete directives, so entries eventually disappear on your other devices. Two things are outside the extension's control:

syncPoint1.message: An entry may be uploaded in the instant between being written and being deleted; the delete directive removes it afterwards.

syncPoint2.message: Chrome syncs your open tabs to other devices, so a protected page is visible there while it is open.

syncStrictAdvice.message: Strict mode: turn off "History" and "Open tabs" in sync settings, and protected addresses are never uploaded.

syncActivityAdvice.message: If your Google Account's Web & App Activity includes Chrome history, consider turning it off as well for strict use.

dataHint.message: Rules are stored on this device only and are not synced. Use import / export to move them between devices.

limit1.message: Not zero-write: entries are written and then deleted immediately, leaving a very short window.

limit2.message: To keep you signed in, cookies and site data are kept, so the domain appears in Chrome's site data list.

limit3.message: Third-party domains used during sign-in (such as SSO) and searches for the site on a search engine need their own rules.

limit4.message: The rule list is stored in plain text on this device and is visible on this page.

limit5.message: Deleting history makes Chrome prune matching back/forward entries in open tabs and clear the "last session" restore data.

limit6.message: If browser policy forbids deleting history (managed devices), the extension cannot work.
